name: Wikidata
useInMysteryMap: Primary seed source for candidate entities and cross-language labels.
risk: Quality varies by item; statements require source checking before publication.

name: OpenStreetMap
useInMysteryMap: Map/navigation verification and POI enrichment, with visible attribution.
risk: ODbL share-alike/database obligations; keep attribution and avoid mixing without tracking provenance.

name: Wikimedia Commons
useInMysteryMap: Candidate image source when each file license and attribution are stored per asset.
risk: License differs per file; never assume all media is CC0.

name: Wikipedia
useInMysteryMap: Use as a fact-discovery and citation-trail source; write original text.
risk: Share-alike text license; do not copy prose into proprietary text.

name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
useInMysteryMap: Authority source for world heritage places, volcanoes, ruins and cultural landscapes.
risk: Treat text/media rights per UNESCO terms; cite and paraphrase.

name: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program
useInMysteryMap: Primary source for earthquake-related disaster/anomaly pages.
risk: Recent feeds are not editorial stories; historic significance still needs curation.

name: USGS APIs
useInMysteryMap: Source registry for USGS machine-readable data pipelines.
risk: Different APIs have different schemas and update cycles.

name: NOAA NCEI Natural Hazards
useInMysteryMap: Primary source for tsunami and natural hazard candidate imports.
risk: Event data needs narrative/editorial conversion before publishing.

name: NOAA Tsunami Program
useInMysteryMap: Authority source for tsunami-related disaster pages and safety framing.
risk: Operational warning data is not a travel recommendation.

name: Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program
useInMysteryMap: Primary source for volcano disaster/anomaly candidates.
risk: Cite GVP version; verify reuse terms before bulk redistribution.

name: NASA History / Tunguska
useInMysteryMap: Authority source for Tunguska and impact-anomaly pages.
risk: Use for science context, not speculative claims.

name: NASA Earth Observatory
useInMysteryMap: Context and imagery lead source for disaster/anomaly pages.
risk: Check image-specific credits where listed.

name: NASA/JPL Small-Body and NEO data
useInMysteryMap: Future source for cosmic anomaly explainers, not location pages by itself.
risk: Technical data requires careful interpretation.

name: GeoNames
useInMysteryMap: Fallback gazetteer and deduplication source.
risk: Requires attribution; quality varies by source and region.

name: Who's On First
useInMysteryMap: Geographic hierarchy and country/region normalization.
risk: Mixed provenance; retain source metadata.

name: Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names
useInMysteryMap: Authority source for historic/cultural place name reconciliation.
risk: Attribution required; API/model integration needs mapping work.

name: World Historical Gazetteer
useInMysteryMap: Historical names and time-aware place reconciliation.
risk: Dataset licenses vary; record provenance per linked dataset.

name: OpenHistoricalMap
useInMysteryMap: Future historical map overlays and context.
risk: Check per-object license/provenance where mixed imports exist.

name: Overture Maps Places
useInMysteryMap: Bulk enrichment and deduplication, not mystery significance.
risk: Some themes may include ODbL-derived data; track theme/license.

name: Foursquare Open Source Places
useInMysteryMap: Possible large-scale POI enrichment with attribution.
risk: Not a mystery source; needs category filtering and verification.

name: Natural Earth
useInMysteryMap: Static world map/basemap generation and country context.
risk: Not detailed enough for exact place navigation.

name: U.S. National Archives Catalog API
useInMysteryMap: Primary archive source for U.S. disaster, war and historical-event evidence.
risk: Some records may include third-party rights; check per item.

name: Digital Public Library of America
useInMysteryMap: Discovery layer for U.S.-based historical imagery and documents.
risk: Media rights vary; store rights statement per asset.

name: Europeana APIs
license: Metadata terms + partner media rights vary
useInMysteryMap: Discovery source for European archival materials.
risk: Content rights vary by provider; use metadata carefully and link back.

name: Library of Congress APIs
useInMysteryMap: Archive source for historic U.S. locations and disaster imagery.
risk: Rights vary by item; verify rights statements.

name: Official local/site websites
useInMysteryMap: Required for practical information before publishing a place page.
risk: Do not copy marketing text; facts can change frequently.

name: MysteryMap community submissions
useInMysteryMap: Lead generation only; every submission requires moderation and source checking.
risk: High misinformation/copyright/privacy risk until moderated.
